title: Gluing compatible local subobjects of an abelian sheaf
statement: Let Q be an abelian sheaf on X_proet, U a pro-etale cover [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering], and q_i:L_i→Q|Ui local monomorphisms. Suppose on each pairwise overlap their pullbacks are isomorphic by c_ij commuting with their inclusions and upperStarCompIso. Then there are a global abelian sheaf P, a monomorphism j:P→Q, and isomorphisms e_i:P|Ui≅L_i commuting with j and q_i. Moreover any m:Z→Q locally factoring through each q_i factors through j. No ring, coefficient field, finite presentation, or scalar-extension claim occurs here.

The canonical local comparisons are isomorphisms by effectivity; use asIso and their proved commutation equations.

theorem exists_subsheaf_of_compatible_local_monomorphisms
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Q : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
    (U : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X)
    (L : ∀ i, Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (U.X i)) Ab.{u + 1})
    (q : ∀ i, L i ⟶ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj Q)
    (hq : ∀ i, Mono (q i))
    (hcompatible : ∀ i j, ∃ c :
      (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (U.f i) (U.f j))).obj (L i) ≅
        (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (U.f i) (U.f j))).obj (L j),
      c.hom ≫ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (U.f i) (U.f j))).map (q j) =
        (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (U.f i) (U.f j))).map (q i) ≫
          (upperStarCompIso Ab.{u + 1}
            (pullback.condition (f := U.f i) (g := U.f j))).hom.app Q) :
    ∃ (P : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (j : P ⟶ Q),
      Mono j ∧ ∃ e : ∀ i, (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj P ≅ L i,
      (∀ i, (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).map j = (e i).hom ≫ q i) ∧
      (∀ (Z : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (m : Z ⟶ Q),
        (∀ i, ∃ t : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj Z ⟶ L i,
          t ≫ q i = (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).map m) →
        ∃ t : Z ⟶ P, t ≫ j = m)
